note: Cautious posture maintained despite positive oil/geopolitics news. Markets are opening strongly (+1%). However, three overlapping risks justify staying cautious today: (1) FOMC meets tomorrow with a rate decision Wednesday — even a likely hold carries surprise risk given Chair Warsh's data-dependent stance and 82% market-implied probability of a September hike; (2) MSFT and AAPL, our two live thesis candidates with full fair-value estimates, both report earnings this week — buying before we see results would add unnecessary risk; (3) the Iran ceasefire is a fragile military pause after 13 nights of strikes, not a diplomatic settlement, and could reverse. Valuations remain elevated at ~20x forward P/E vs 15x long-run average. 10-year yield at 4.63% is still high. None of our thesis candidates are near buy thresholds regardless of posture (MSFT at $389.85 needs ~$333 at normal or ~$310 at cautious; V at $363.84 is 22% above fair value; AAPL at $336.41 is 72% above fair value with only conviction-3).
